messages.content: Hey, it's your weekly check-in from Northline Care. How's the week been treating you? Any blood sugar or blood pressure numbers to share?

Not bad I guess. Fasting sugar this morning was 148. Hey quick question — my doctor keeps saying lay off the bread but I live 40 miles from the nearest grocery store. What am I supposed to eat instead?

Got it, logging your fasting reading of 148 for this morning. On the bread question — that one's outside what I'm able to help with. Diet advice isn't something this system handles, and I wouldn't want to steer you wrong. Your care team or a dietitian would be the right place to bring that one. Is anything else going on this week — any symptoms or medication issues?
No nothing like that. Metformin is getting low, maybe a week left, but I called the pharmacy already so should be fine.

Good that you're on top of it — refills are another thing I can't process from here, but sounds like you've got it handled. I'll note the metformin supply in your record. Your next check-in will come through same time next week. Reach out sooner if anything changes.

theme: diet question, what to eat instead of bread
